name: Transactions
expr: SUM('Sessions'[transactions])
description: Distinct purchase transactions (transaction_id). 5,281 vs 5,692 purchase events: some transactions fire purchase twice.

name: AOV
expr: DIVIDE([Revenue], [Transactions])
description: REVISED. Average order value = Revenue / Transactions. The deployed version divides by purchase events, which double-counts duplicated purchase hits and understates AOV ($63.63 vs $68.58).

name: Revenue per Purchase Event
expr: DIVIDE([Revenue], [Purchases])

name: Converting Sessions

name: Returning Users

name: New User Share

name: Pages per Session

name: Period Label
expr:
VAR _s = [Period Start]
VAR _e = [Period End]
RETURN
SWITCH(TRUE(),
    ISBLANK(_s), BLANK(),
    _s = DATE(YEAR(_s), MONTH(_s), 1) && _e = EOMONTH(_s, 0), FORMAT(_s, "mmmm yyyy"),
    YEAR(_s) = YEAR(_e), FORMAT(_s, "mmm d") & " – " & FORMAT(_e, "mmm d, yyyy"),
    FORMAT(_s, "mmm d, yyyy") & " – " & FORMAT(_e, "mmm d, yyyy"))

name: PP Start
expr:
VAR _s = [Period Start]
VAR _e = [Period End]
VAR _d = [Period Days]
VAR _full = _s = DATE(YEAR(_s), MONTH(_s), 1) && _e = EOMONTH(_s, 0)
VAR _ps = IF(_full, EDATE(_s, -1), _s - _d)
VAR _pe = IF(_full, EOMONTH(_s, -1), _s - 1)
VAR _min = CALCULATE(MIN('Date'[date]), REMOVEFILTERS('Date'))
RETURN IF(_ps >= _min, _ps)

name: PP End
expr:
VAR _s = [Period Start]
VAR _e = [Period End]
VAR _d = [Period Days]
VAR _full = _s = DATE(YEAR(_s), MONTH(_s), 1) && _e = EOMONTH(_s, 0)

VAR _pe = IF(_full, EOMONTH(_s, -1), _s - 1)
VAR _min = CALCULATE(MIN('Date'[date]), REMOVEFILTERS('Date'))
RETURN IF(_ps >= _min, _pe)

name: PP Label
expr:
VAR _ps = [PP Start]
VAR _pe = [PP End]
RETURN
SWITCH(TRUE(),
    ISBLANK(_ps), "no earlier period in data",
    _ps = DATE(YEAR(_ps), MONTH(_ps), 1) && _pe = EOMONTH(_ps, 0), "vs " & FORMAT(_ps, "mmm yyyy"),

expr:
VAR _t = FILTER(ADDCOLUMNS(ALLSELECTED('Page Type'[page_path]), "@s", [Sessions], "@rps", [Revenue per Session]), [@s] > 0)
VAR _site = CALCULATE([Revenue per Session], ALLSELECTED('Page Type'))

VAR _ix = DIVIDE(MAXX(_top, [@rps]), _site)
RETURN
"Home lands " & FORMAT([Home Session Share], "0%") & " of sessions and " & FORMAT([Home Revenue Share], "0%") & " of revenue" &
IF(NOT ISBLANK(_path), "; " & _name & " pulls " & FORMAT(_s / 1000, "0.0") & "K sessions at " & FORMAT(_ix, "0.00") & "× the average yield.", ".")
